newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech Danone-Nestle unit to pay CZK 70 gross div.
newsitem.headline: Czech Danone-Nestle unit to pay CZK 70 gross div.

text.p: Shareholders of Czech confectioner Cokoladovny a.s., majority-owned by a consortium comprised of Groupe Danone and Nestle SA, voted on Monday to pay a 70 crown gross dividend per share on 1996 earnings after 50 crowns in the previous year, the Czech news agency CTK reported.
The consortium, called Cokoladovny Partners, holds an 83 percent stake in the Czech company.
The Prague-based Cokoladovny showed a 735 million crown net profit last year, after 516 million in 1995.
Company officials were not immediately available to confirm the CTK report.
